title: A Autopsy for the Ledger
author: Rafael Okonkwo
blurb: Gideon Fairweather, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
